purpose: Portable instrumentation and cross-system baseline; no algorithm, tile, thread, or cache-format tuning.
source_commit: 61be38c plus uncommitted benchmark/instrumentation changes captured in code-final.tar.gz

supplemental_hardware.mac_ram_source: sysctl -n hw.memsize from previous production test; optional psutil RAM probe unavailable in benchmark environment
supplemental_hardware.linux_storage: Input copied to /tmp on /dev/nvme0n1p2; spool/cache also on this NVMe filesystem
supplemental_hardware.mac_storage: Input symlink to existing scratch copy; spool/cache on local /private/tmp APFS volume

notes: All full-panel fingerprints match across hosts and the previous production test; all subset fingerprints match with timing off/on on both hosts.

Full-panel timings are one instrumented load per host, no workload warmup, imports/hashing excluded. Input checksums read before tests; not controlled cold-storage tests. First-load/JIT effects included.
Subset timings: same first 1M markers, gzip level 1, one warmup and three timed runs per condition; off condition precedes on on each host. Not a randomized overhead experiment.

Full/subset production measurements started after setup/transfers/tests. mac-1m-stages is an earlier pilot overlapping transfer and using an earlier counter-only code revision; retained but excluded from headline baselines.
Native runtime thread settings retained: Mac Numba 10, Linux Numba 24. OS, libraries, CPU, RAM and filesystem differ. These runs do not isolate a hardware-only or RAM-only effect.
Resource counters are raw snapshots; RSS normalized to bytes on Darwin/Linux. Peak RSS is process-wide and includes hashing/warmup where applicable. Other systems can report null.
Linux /proc/self/io is process-attributed I/O, not complete physical-device tracing. Macintosh block counters are zero/unavailable here, not proof of no disk I/O.
Logical byte counters are not physical I/O or peak allocated disk usage. Spool-plus-output capacity excludes metadata, source and any preexisting cache; sparse capacity can exceed allocation.
Timing stages are nested; inclusive times overlap, exclusive times sum to the instrumented load total. Stream residual includes parsing, QC, genotype decoding and untimed buffered I/O.
speedup fields in subset on reports are instrumentation-off/on ratios, not algorithmic speedups.
No production VCFs or caches changed on beadledesktop. Scratch copies and caches retained; no commit/push performed.
